_comment: Remote-body interpolation vectors, written by scripts/gen_hassault_vectors.py. 'rewinds' are the server's own PositionHistory.rewind and pin the one curve a shot is judged on and a body is drawn along. 'extrapolations' and 'interpClock' are the clients' render clock, from the reference InterpClock in the generator. Replayed by backend/tests/test_hassault_weapons.py, packages/core/src/modules/hassault/__tests__/interp-vectors.test.ts and apps/native-fps/tests/conformance.rs.
